scope: All 6 public task definitions in the pinned release; 100 advertised full-suite tasks. Agentic provisional ID.
assessment_scope: Every public question and metadata record manually assessed. Input schemas, biological fixtures, execution and actual scorer behavior remain uninspected. Scorer type names are metadata only. Expected-answer configuration was omitted from the saved metadata projection and was not read for authoring.

inventory_completeness.discrepancy: README says seven examples; manifest and nontruncated tree agree on the recorded count. No IDs invented for the unavailable full-suite remainder.

license_and_contamination: Root Apache-2.0 license; public manifest separately excludes benchmark data from training. Inputs, graders and ground truth are withheld.

task_defaults.assessment: public-prompt-pattern-assessed; inputs and executable scoring uninspected
remaining_gaps: Select independent observed biological data and check source lineage and reuse terms; benchmark prompts, answers, trajectories and fixtures are excluded from the training corpus.
Specify quantitative intermediate artifacts, full output populations and decision criteria that can be verified without an LLM judge.
Implement and run a connected private oracle with negative controls and an offline task budget of at most 30 minutes.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Audit representation coverage and predictive evidence at previously unvaried sequence positions
required_stages: compare library and held-out sequences with the common background
identify varied and incidental positions and reconstruct encoding
fit the stated classification models using only the training library
evaluate both measured properties on the precisely identified novel-position cohort
scientific_decisions: Novel amino-acid positions and novel combinations at known positions are distinct shifts. Preserve the exact evaluation population; define significance tests and encoding behavior without using held-out labels for fitting.

source_metadata.discovery_competency: Binder generation and primary hit selection
source_metadata.assay_modality: Sorted antibody display library with sequence-based (LDA) property models

tasks.workflow_pattern: Compare classifier agreement and multi-rater reliability across distinct annotation panels
required_stages: reconcile image identities, panel membership and independent rater labels
compute appropriate agreement baselines for each available panel
separate training-condition annotation reliability from new-condition validation
report which generalization claims are supported
scientific_decisions: The second panel has no model predictions, and same-condition reliability cannot directly quantify a new-stimulus performance drop. Keep images, raters and biological conditions distinct.

source_metadata.discovery_competency: Cellular pharmacology and mechanism of action
source_metadata.assay_modality: Imaging flow cytometry with a synapse-classification model and inter-rater reliability panels

tasks.workflow_pattern: Summarize organ exposure while assessing what a radiolabel can establish about persistence
required_stages: join animal, candidate, organ and sampling-time identities
calculate observed organ/time summaries with replicate counts
assess label chemistry and limits of intact-drug inference
separate observed persistence from supported dosing claims
scientific_decisions: Radiolabel signal and intact biologic concentration are different quantities. Replicate variation and label retention bias are separate limits; these descriptive data do not independently validate a dosing interval.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Reconcile concentration, tissue fractionation and microscopy for delivery assessment
required_stages: align candidate identities, timepoints and measurement methods
compute the specified concentration comparison
distinguish vascular signal from parenchymal localization
apply an explicit hierarchy of evidence for delivery
scientific_decisions: Whole-organ signal does not establish delivery to the desired compartment. Validate fractionation purity and imaging localization; scalar concentration ratios alone do not check the decision workflow.

source_metadata.assay_modality: Whole-brain concentration, capillary-depletion fractionation, and fluorescence microscopy

tasks.workflow_pattern: Compare payload localization with carrier uptake before interpreting delivery
required_stages: join carrier, linker, cell and time identities
calculate nuclear and cytoplasmic payload endpoints
compare payload localization with matched carrier-uptake measurements
report the delivery conclusion under a defined compartment rule
scientific_decisions: Total fluorescence, nuclear fraction and uptake correlation are different endpoints. Use matched units and explicit image-analysis/decision contracts; intensity alone does not establish effective delivery.

source_metadata.discovery_competency: Cellular pharmacology and mechanism of action
source_metadata.assay_modality: Per-cell immunofluorescence (nuclear/cytoplasmic payload) with live-cell internalization movies

tasks.workflow_pattern: Reconcile posted longitudinal outcomes with a fitted population model to assess readout timing
required_stages: parse arm-by-visit outcome records and fitted model parameters
distinguish target, efficacy and safety readouts
compute observed arm comparisons and lineage time-scale ratios
apply explicit criteria for readout suitability and timing
scientific_decisions: The released prompt requests free-text reasoning and several decisions without exposing the scorer. Keep observed readouts distinct from model-implied dynamics; predefined criteria are needed for a judge-free adaptation.

source_metadata.assay_modality: Posted repeat-dose study results and a population haematopoiesis model
